title: Maximum Lysis on Thromboelastography as a Marker of Systemic Severity in Acute Allergic Reactions
official: Maximum Lysis on Thromboelastography as a Marker of Systemic Severity in Acute Allergic Reactions
summary: The purpose of this research is to better understand the mechanisms behind allergic reactions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 12 years or older.
* Presentation to the emergency department with suspected allergic reaction, anaphylaxis, or angioedema based on chief concern.
* Ability to obtain thromboelastography during the acute presentation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known inherited coagulation or fibrinolytic disorders.
* Active major bleeding at presentation.
* Receipt of thrombolytic therapy.
* Inability to obtain thromboelastography promptly.
